events.title: Oasis's Debut Album Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your favourite track from this era-defining album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in 1969, defining a generation.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the original Woodstock. Three days of peace, love, and music that became a cultural landmark. Imagine being there!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on this day in 1977; he would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legend live on.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996; he would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a true icon. Remembering Tupac Shakur and his unparalleled impact on music and culture. His words still resonate.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970; he would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since the world lost the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His guitar wizardry continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous ever, but what's your top track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and rock 'n' roll attitude have given us so many classics.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll energy. What's your favourite Oasis track he sang?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song whose message of peace and unity is as relevant today as it was then.

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music In Your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your all-time favourite 007 moment or song?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track stands out most for you?
